name: ballerina/data.jsondata
description: The Ballerina JSON Data Library is a comprehensive toolkit designed to facilitate the handling and manipulation of JSON data within Ballerina applications. It streamlines the process of converting JSON data to native Ballerina data types, enabling developers to work with JSON content seamlessly and efficiently.

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description:
Represents the error type of the ballerina/data.jsondata module. This error type represents any error that can occur
during the execution of jsondata APIs.

typeDefs.name: Options
typeDefs.description: Represent the options that can be used to modify the behaviour of the projection.

typeDefs.name: NameConfig
typeDefs.description: Defines the name of the JSON Object key.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The name of the JSON Object key

functions.name: parseAsType
functions.description: Convert value of type `json` to subtype of `anydata`.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description: On success, returns value belonging to the given target type, else returns an `jsondata:Error` value.

functions.name: parseString
functions.description: Converts JSON string to subtype of anydata.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Source JSON string value or byte[] or byte-block-stream

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description: On success, value belonging to the given target type, else returns an `jsondata:Error` value.

functions.name: parseBytes
functions.description: Converts JSON byte[] to subtype of anydata.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description: On success, value belonging to the given target type, else returns an `jsondata:Error` value.

functions.name: parseStream
functions.description: Converts JSON byte-block-stream to subtype of anydata.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description: On success, value belonging to the given target type, else returns an `jsondata:Error` value.

functions.name: toJson
functions.description: Converts a value of type `anydata` to `json`.

return.description: representation of `v` as value of type json

functions.name: prettify
functions.description: Prettifies a `json` value to print it.

parameters.name: indentation
parameters.description: The number of spaces for an indentation

functions.name: read
functions.description:
Extract details from the given JSON value using the provided query template expression.

```ballerina
read({id: 1, "name": "John Doe"}, `$.name`) => "John Doe"
```

return.description: extracted details as JSON value, a jsonpath:Error otherwise

annotations.name: Name
annotations.description: The annotation is used to overwrite the existing record field name.
